Blood Curse Update
Before KMW, the Blood Curse was tied to what clan a vampire was. Every
Assamite had the Blood Curse even if card text didn't say so (unless card
text explicitly overrode that, of course). Now, as of KMW, the Blood Curse
only affects the vampires whose card text say so (just like all of the other
attributes: Scarce, Cold Iron Vulnerability, Sterile, etc.).

So Assamite Embraces and vampires that Clan Impersonate an Assamite don't
acquire the Curse, and an Assamite Impersonating another clan won't lose it.

Raille

Messages.Author: Matthew T. Morgan
Messages.Body:



It's obviously reminder text. I'm glad it's there. Ever played with
someone who's not up on the latest rules and expansions? Sometimes I get
suspicious glances as I explain the new rules and cards.

Imagine...

Me: Michael DiCarlo diablerizes Arika. Block?
Oldbie: Sorry, but he can't. He's Blood Cursed.
Me: No, actually that rule was changed. Michael's text doesn't indicate
that he's Blood Cursed, so that means he isn't.
Oldbie: Let me see that card.
Me: Sure, but it doesn't say anything about the Blood Curse...
Oldbie: It doesn't say he's not Blood Cursed.
Me: Right, I'm telling you that because it doesn't say he is, that means
he isn't.
Oldbie: It doesn't say he isn't. [turns to fellow oldbie] What do you
think?
Olderbie: It would say if the Blood Curse doesn't affect him, just like
Tariq.
Oldbie: Yeah, like Tariq. Sorry, but you can't take that action.
Me: *sigh* Fine. Michael hunts. Any problem with that?

Compare to...

Me: Michael DiCarlo diablerizes Arika.
Oldbie: Isn't he Blood Cursed?
Me: Nope. Says so right here.
Oldbie: Crap! No block.

Matt Morgan
